entities.summary: Gloria Chang Wan-ki is a Hong Kong environmental activist who served as president of the Hong Kong University Students' Union in 2000. She was a main critic of the university leaders during the "Pollgate" controversy concerning government pressure on Robert Chung Ting-yiu, who conducted polls.
